DitherSlider.value: The current value (or lower value in range mode).
DitherSlider.value-high: The upper value in two-thumb range mode.
DitherSlider.is-range: When true, displays two lit notched thumbs and fills between them.
DitherSlider.step: The value snaps to multiples of this from minimum. 0 is smooth.
DitherSlider.variant: thumb for notched lit thumb; bar for seamless draggable meter bar.
DitherSlider.segments: When > 1, divides the track into discrete blocks with 1-cell gaps.
DitherSlider.ticks: When true, renders step tick marks under the track lit within active range.
DitherSlider.label: Label text displayed above the track.
DitherSlider.hide-label: Hides the label title while keeping the value readout.
DitherSlider.unit: Unit suffix displayed beside the readout (e.g. "%" or " dB").
DitherSlider.show-value: Shows live numeric readout next to the label.
DitherSlider.show-range: Shows minimum and maximum values under the track edges.
DitherSlider.color: Colour of the fill and the thumb.
DitherSlider.size: sm, md or lg: tracks of 6, 8 and 12 pixels with thumbs 20, 24 and 30 pixels tall.
DitherSlider.bloom: low or high adds a glow in the slider's colour.
DitherSlider.matrix: The dither pattern of the fill.
DitherSlider.animated: Enables smooth 180ms ease-out glide on clicks, steps, and value changes, with 0ms drag latency.
DitherSlider.enabled: Drops to 45% opacity and ignores the pointer and keys when false.
DitherSlider.range-start-text: Text for the low end of a range slider, in place of the value.
DitherSlider.range-end-text: Text for the high end of a range slider, in place of the value.
DitherSlider.dragging: Whether the thumb is being dragged. Read only.
DitherSlider.changed: Called with the new value while dragging and on key presses.
